dealerPicker.title: Payouts
dealerPicker.description: Pick a dealer to view their ledger, record a payout, or add an adjustment.
dealerPicker.notice: Payouts are always viewed per dealer. Only approved dealers appear here.
dealerPicker.searchPlaceholder: Search by business name or email

ledger.title: Payout ledger
ledger.description: Append-only record of commissions earned, payouts recorded, and manual adjustments for this dealer.
ledger.moneyDisclaimer: Recording a payout here documents a payment that was already completed outside Giftory (e.g. a bank transfer). It does not send any money — Giftory has no disbursement integration yet.

balance.pendingHint: Earned but not yet paid out, net of recorded payouts and debit adjustments
balance.earnedHint: Commissions only — unaffected by payouts or adjustments

filters.dateRangeTooltip: Filters only the entries currently loaded on this page, not the full history

table.title: Ledger entries
table.empty: No ledger entries yet for this dealer.

error.dealerNotFound: Dealer not found or not approved

ledgerDialog.moneyNotice: Giftory has no payment disbursement integration yet. Complete the transfer in your banking system first, then record it here for the ledger.

error.invalidAmount: Enter a whole or 2-decimal rupee amount greater than zero

recordPayoutDialog.title: Record payout
recordPayoutDialog.description: This only documents that a payment was already completed outside Giftory (e.g. a bank transfer). It does not send any money.
recordPayoutDialog.referencePlaceholder: Bank transfer UTR, cheque number, or other proof of payment

adjustmentDialog.title: Add ledger adjustment
adjustmentDialog.description: Use this to correct the ledger — e.g. a reversed commission or a manual credit. This never edits or removes an existing entry; it always appends a new one.
adjustmentDialog.directionCredit: Credit — increases the dealer's pending balance
adjustmentDialog.directionDebit: Debit — decreases the dealer's pending balance

error.missingReason: A reason is required for every adjustment
